name: unlink_node
declaration: unsafe fn unlink_node (& mut self , mut node : NonNull < Node < T > >)
documentation:
Unlinks the specified node from the current list.

 Warning: this will not check that the provided node belongs to the current list.

 This method takes care not to create mutable references to `element`, to
 maintain validity of aliasing pointers.
rules: For safety, `node` must belong to the current list; `unlink_node` does not check this.
`unlink_node` does not create mutable references to node `element` fields, preserving the validity of aliasing pointers.
